svg.desc: Source-coordinate material ledger projection. Finished material and the kerf, milling, trim, and other-offcut losses are shown once only; live intermediate parts are excluded.
svg.text: Exploded Z slabs show separate depths. Colours identify disposition; outlines preserve source-region boundaries.
